CORRECTION (066, 2026-08-17): the '400-tick own-handling floor' asserted throughout every note above (046-065) is WRONG. User pushback, tested directly: Grass.md says outright 'Grass grows automatically on grassland' -- harvest() never leaves the tile empty, get_companion() rerolls fresh every single cycle with no plant() call, and the champion's instructions() call after harvest() is a guarded plant() whose guard always skips (entity_type never leaves Grass) -- measured at 7 ticks, not 200, in 6/6 cycles. Real own-handling cost: harvest (200) + instructions (7) = ~207, not 400. This halves the reroll cost R used in every servicing-cost estimate since 046: S = R(1-p)/p drops from ~800 to ~414, and the zero-servicing floor (own-handling + 415 growth) drops from ~815 to ~622 -- well BELOW the #2-10 cluster's ~750-856 band, not barely inside it. This does NOT overturn 051/053-055/058-061's specific measured results (real game runs, unaffected by a wrong model) but DOES overturn the narrative built on them ('057 is at the true optimum, further tuning can't help, the paradigm is servicing-bound') -- that reasoning used the wrong number throughout. PERFECT-TIMING FLOOR (user reframe, 2026-08-17): re-derived the theoretical floor precisely, separating what's sequential from what overlaps. harvest() (200) is unavoidable; instructions()/replant is fully droppable (0, not 7 -- Grass auto-regrows even without the guard call, confirmed in 066 round 2). growth (415) is unavoidable. The walk from Common.polyculture_mapped overlaps with growth (it's called before the ripeness check), so it's max(415, walk), not additive -- but the reroll chase does NOT overlap with anything (it happens immediately after harvest(), sequentially), so each reroll is a flat +207. Perfect-timing floor (zero rerolls, zero walks ever needed) = 200 + 415 = 615, tighter than the earlier 622. #1's implied ~409-466 budget sits BELOW even this tightest honest floor -- not a modeling artifact, a mechanical minimum.
